mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) above historical trend triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved labor market confidence and reduced uncertainty.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns in non-recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals tightening monetary policy, reducing growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or if the rate crosses above 4.0% without a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) creates a dual signal of monetary easing and labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE decline does not correlate with positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 60 days) or if one variable moves against the expected direction.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above historical trend triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to heightened growth expectations.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, GDPC1 above trend does not significantly predict positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the regime is misclassified.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly industrial production (INDPRO) above trend signals robust supply-side activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects strong economic output.
failure_condition: INDPRO above trend does not correlate with positive returns within 5 days (Rank IC < 0.03) or if the trend is not accurately identified.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 5.0% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as it signals labor market strength and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 does not show significant positive returns when UNRATE crosses below 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or if the threshold is not consistently met.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and INDPRO rises does not predict positive returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 60 days) or if one variable moves against the other.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, sustained employment growth (PAYEMS) above trend triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as it signals labor market recovery and economic momentum.
failure_condition: In post-recession periods, PAYEMS above trend does not significantly correlate with positive returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the recovery phase is misclassified.
